_comment: Single source of truth for the portfolio's PUBLIC disclosures. Each record renders the site #disclosures row AND a sota-bench README line via tools/generate_disclosures.py. ADD a credit = append one record + run the generator (with --verify). A record renders ONLY if proof.published is true AND it carries a url (fail-closed). NEVER add a finding whose advisory is not live-published: the generator's --verify mode re-checks each proof against the live GitHub state, so an embargoed/triage/un-realized finding cannot ship. Order here is the on-site order: severity score descending.
_embargo_rule: proof.published must be backed by a LIVE state check at publish time (repo security-advisory state==published, OR presence in the GitHub global advisory DB), NEVER a stored string. Findings still in private coordination are intentionally NOT listed here until their advisory or credit actually publishes.

findings.name: dex
findings.desc: Token-exchange endpoint missing per-client connector ACL enforcement (CWE-285). Reporter fix-PR merged.

proof.note: Accepted + reporter-credited; no CVE (master-only, no released tag carried the bug). Citation is the repo advisory URL; not in the GitHub global DB by design.

findings.name: Open WebUI
findings.desc: Stored XSS via an OAuth picture claim stored as an SVG data URI (CWE-79). Patched 0.9.5.

proof.note: Published in the GitHub global advisory DB (severity high). No CVE assigned yet (cve=null); cite as GHSA, not CVE.

findings.name: MCP Registry
findings.desc: Unauthenticated SSRF bypassing the private-address allowlist via 6to4 / NAT64 (CWE-918). CVE-2026-44430.

proof.note: Published in the GitHub global advisory DB with CVE-2026-44430.

findings.name: GitHub MCP Server
findings.desc: Lockdown-mode RepoAccessCache singleton in HTTP mode binds every user's repo-access checks to the first authenticated user's GraphQL token: cross-user authorization confusion (CWE-284). CVE-2026-48529. Credited reporter (co-reported). Patched 1.1.2.

proof.note: Repo advisory published 2026-06-09 with CVE-2026-48529 (CVSS 6.0, CWE-284 Improper Access Control). Not yet synced to the GitHub global advisory DB (lag, like Outline). matte1782 is a credited reporter, co-reported with hewei-gikaku (not sole discoverer). Citation is the public repo advisory URL (anonymous HTTP 200).

findings.name: Kirby
findings.desc: Content locks disclose IDs and emails of otherwise-inaccessible users (CWE-862). CVE-2026-45334.

proof.note: Published in the GitHub global advisory DB with CVE-2026-45334.

findings.name: Outline
findings.desc: Cross-tenant IDOR in subscription creation on private documents (CWE-639). CVE-2026-43890.

proof.note: Repo advisory is published with CVE-2026-43890 assigned, but the CVE is ABSENT from the GitHub global advisory DB (known discrepancy). Citation is the repo advisory URL (solid + published); verify the CVE via NVD before citing the CVE number in isolation.
